ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, quadrilateral AEFH and quadrilateral ABCD are similar figures, with a similarity ratio of $\frac{2}{3}$. If the area of quadrilateral ABCD is 900 cm$^2$, then what is the area of quadrilateral AEFH in cm$^2$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Because quadrilateral AEFH and quadrilateral ABCD are similar figures with a similarity ratio of $\frac{2}{3}$,\\
therefore, the ratio of the area of quadrilateral AEFH to the area of quadrilateral ABCD is $4\colon 9$,\\
furthermore, since the area of quadrilateral ABCD is $900\text{cm}^{2}$,\\
therefore, the area of quadrilateral AEFH is $\boxed{400\text{cm}^{2}}$.
